author: Nelev
body:
## Why

The agent code was split across `agent/` and `langchain_agent/`, which imported from each other (`langchain_agent.agent → agent.documents → langchain_agent.rag`). `langchain_agent/rag.py` did two jobs, the indexing script and the record lookup the API uses on every upload. And `rag_pipeline/` still carried the dead Chroma path.

## What moved

| From | To |
|---|---|
| `agent/assistant_general_prompt.py`, `documents.py`, `patient.py` | `langchain_agent/` |
| `agent/search.py` | `rag_pipeline/search.py` |
| `langchain_agent/rag.py` (ingest) | `rag_pipeline/ingest.py` |
| `load_record` / `find_record` / `MEDICAL_HISTORY_PATH` (were in `rag.py`) | new `rag_pipeline/record.py` |
| `rag_pipeline/medical_history.json` | `dataset/records/medical_history.json` |

Deleted: `rag_pipeline/run.py`, `rag_pipeline/embeddings.py`, the `chromadb` dependency (relocked), and `langchain_agent/text_vectorizer.py`, which nothing imported and which was broken (`self.model` was never set).

Imports now run one way: `controller → langchain_agent → rag_pipeline`. CLAUDE.md records this.

## Behaviour

No change. The only new entry point is the ingest command, **`uv run python -m rag_pipeline.ingest`** (was `langchain_agent.rag`). The README, CLAUDE.md and the dataset README are updated to match. The README also drops the Chroma known-gap entry and now says the agent has two tools, not three.

## Checks

- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` (165 passed), `uv lock --check`
- `rag_pipeline.ingest`, `langchain_agent.agent`, `dataset.eval.run_eval`, `dataset.eval.rag_metrics` and `main` all import cleanly, and `load_record()` reads the moved JSON
